analysis:
MARKET & PORTFOLIO OVERVIEW: SPY is in a healthy uptrend (+3.5% vs SMA50, +0.85% slope), so macro backdrop is constructive. However, the portfolio is essentially at full capacity: 94% deployed across 5 positions with only $1,077 of headroom remaining — not enough to meaningfully size any new entry. The hard cap is 95% gross, so no new BUY is practically feasible today.

EXISTING POSITION REVIEW:
• A (+14.66%): Thesis intact, clean uptrend. No action needed. Consider whether to let it run toward LTCG threshold (entered ~8-9 months ago based on hold time implied by FDS trades).
• LMT (+5.52%): Defense spending thesis intact, positive trend. Hold.
• AMP (+3.63%): Wealth management compounder, modest gain, no thesis break. Hold.
• MCO (+1.48%): Moody's is a high-quality toll-road business. Slow start but no deterioration. Hold.
• TEL (-0.37%): Essentially at cost. In candidate list as UPTREND (basing), fwd P/E 16.6x, 13.8% revenue growth. Slightly below SMA200 (-1.9%) is a yellow flag but not a thesis break. No stop triggered. Hold with vigilance — a close below ~$204 (near 200-day and prior support) would prompt reassessment.

PERFORMANCE CONCERN: Profit factor of 0.55 and Sortino of -1.90 are below acceptable thresholds, driven largely by three consecutive WDAY stop-outs. The lesson: avoid chasing extended breakouts in high-multiple software names. Current positions are more defensively valued (fwd P/Es in the 15–20x range for most names).

NEW TRADE DECISION: With $1,077 of remaining capacity, no new position can be sized to even 1% of equity without breaching the gross cap. Several candidates are genuinely interesting (ADBE at fwd 9.93x P/E with 12.7% revenue growth in a basing pattern; CRM at fwd 12.73x with 13.3% growth; BRO with 32.4% revenue growth and clean uptrend) — but entering any of them with $1,077 would be a token rounding error, not a real position. Forcing a micro-entry to 'stay busy' is exactly the discipline failure this strategy warns against.

RECOMMENDATION: Hold all five positions. Keep $6K cash as dry powder. If TEL breaks below ~$204 and stops out, that frees ~$18–19K to rotate into one of the higher-conviction candidates (ADBE or BRO) at proper sizing. Patience here IS the alpha — manufacturing a sixth trade with $1K available capital would be noise, not signal.
